questionText:

Statement I: A Second Class Lever (Load between Fulcrum and Effort, e.g., plantarflexion at the ankle joint) always operates with a Mechanical Advantage greater than 1.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. Second class levers magnify force (MA > 1); third class levers magnify speed and displacement (MA < 1).
Hence Option D is correct.
